pose: neutral balanced biped with long arms and horizontal tail
anatomy: adult single thin fenestrated crest, four lateral supports, long three-fingered hands

crest_thickness_m.basis: Main blade thickened above fossil approx 1.5 mm for legible robust low-poly surfaces; posterior widening approximates reported 13 mm.

crest_external_windows: Open exterior fenestrae are an artistic treatment exposing the fossil bony framework, not evidence of holes through the living skin.
crest_missing_anterior: Restored using shaded unpreserved contour in Fig 2 of Xu et al 2006.
